title: WATER & VACUUM WATER TEST
summary: Factory water-leak test spec: the car is sprayed (and vacuum-tested with a blower and manometer through a window) before seats, door trim pads, carpet and cowl trim go in, and lists which seals and areas must be checked for convertible soft top, C07 hardtop and coupe (19437): windshield header seal, side roof rail seal to door glass, rear quarter seal, rear bow seal, lock pillar top, T-top/roof panel and rear window seals, door openings, underbody joints and body bolts. Useful for tracking down water leaks.
notes: Spray test: assembled and sealed car must show no water leaks under a stationary spray test to the engineering water and vacuum water test specs.
Test before seat cushions, door trim pads, carpet and cowl trim panels are installed, with the cowl ventilator closed, so leaks can be seen.

Spray at least 4 minutes; full-cone nozzles with 60° included angle, Spraying Systems Co. "Full Jet" No. V2 GG-25 or equivalent (3.3 gal per min), 18 P.S.I. at the nozzle. Nozzle distance and angle per diagram.

Water test, folding top: header seal to W/S header; side roof rail seal to door glass; rear quarter seal to rear edge of door glass; rear bow seal to body; top of lock pillar; W/S post to door post to header seal; all exposed seams and tacking strips.

Water test, RPO C07 hard top: header seal to W/S header; side roof rail seal to door glass; rear quarter seal to rear edge of door glass; rear bow seal to body; top of lock pillar; W/S post to door post to hard top header seal.
Water test, 19437 coupe: header seal to W/S header; side roof rail seal to door; rear quarter seal to rear edge of door; rear window seals to roof panel.
Hard top and 19437 coupe: check all molding and riveted joint attachments, e.g. drip molding to roof rail seal, and the full perimeter of the back windows.
Vacuum water test (blower connected and manometer reading through a window, per diagram): windshield - full glass perimeter and all attaching areas under the instrument panel.

Vacuum test, doors: W/S side frame to door post frame, full door opening perimeter, and all holes and cover plates on the door inner panel, especially the bottom of the door (inner panel / sill plate area).
Vacuum test, rear compartment: folding top lid to body seal.

Vacuum test, underbody/dash/rocker: all joints, holes and cover plates on dash and rear compartment panel to underbody joint, dash panel to underbody joint, body bolts, and rear compartment at the wheelhouse.
Vacuum test, miscellaneous: check all attachments of moldings, emblems and other parts that protrude into the passenger or rear compartment.
NOTE Nozzles D, B, & C are not used when Vacuum Testing Soft Top.
NOTE A slight dripping of water, when required fit is obtained, between the rear glass w/strip and the door w/strip is to be considered acceptable on 19467 models.
